name: travel_workflow
description: End-to-end corporate travel booking workflow including flight, hotel, approval, and finance

steps.name: validation
steps.description: Validate employee identity, passport, and request completeness

steps.name: policy_check
steps.description: Query policy knowledge base for applicable travel rules and budget limits

steps.name: flight_search
steps.description: Search for available flights and select best option per policy

steps.name: hotel_search
steps.description: Search and select hotel accommodation at destination

steps.name: manager_approval
steps.description: Request manager approval for travel authorization

steps.name: finance_processing
steps.description: Create invoice, allocate budget, and initiate payment process

steps.name: notification
steps.description: Notify employee, manager, and finance of completed booking

steps.name: audit
steps.description: Create immutable audit trail for the completed workflow
